snippet.title: The UNDERTALE + DELTARUNE Soundtracks Come to Trombone Champ!
snippet.description:
This DLC song pack brings 14 songs from the UNDERTALE and DELTARUNE Soundtracks to Trombone Champ!

Warning: A lot of these tracks are incredibly difficult! This DLC is intended for players with Trombone Champ experience!

Grab the DLC here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3955770/Trombone_Champ_UNDERTALE__DELTARUNE_Song_Pack/

FROM UNDERTALE...
- Bonetrousle - Toby Fox
- Dummy! - Toby Fox
- Metal Crusher - Toby Fox
- Hopes and Dreams - Toby Fox
- ASGORE - Toby Fox
- Battle Against a True Hero - Toby Fox
- Megalovania - Toby Fox

FROM DELTARUNE...
- Rude Buster - Toby Fox
- Scarlet Forest - Toby Fox
- The World Revolving - Toby Fox
- A CYBER'S WORLD? - Toby Fox
- Attack of the Killer Queen - Toby Fox, Lena Raine, Marcy Nabors
- Pandora Palace - Toby Fox
- BIG SHOT - Toby Fox

... AND NOW WITH BONUS TRACKS FROM CHAPTERS 3+4:
- TV World - Toby Fox
- It's TV Time! - Toby Fox
- Black Knife - Toby Fox
- SWORD - Toby Fox
- Dark Sanctuary + Neverending Night - Toby Fox
- The Third Sanctuary - Toby Fox
- GUARDIAN - Toby Fox

DELTARUNE Chapter 1 Soundtrack © 2018 Materia Collective / Materia Music Inc.

DELTARUNE Chapter 3+4 Soundtrack © 2025 Materia Collective / Materia Music Inc. under exclusive license from Royal Sciences LLC
